tasks.title: Install Tarik's handoff-only wake worker and continuity fix on the Mac
tasks.reason_for_goose: Codex has no access to the Mac's live bot files, launchd service, or local run state. Tarik-Goose already has that local execution capability.
tasks.instructions: Verified worker and portable tests are available in private commit f81a160a120a9cc6fc13fab740984e4f4ff3be43; expected local_tick.py Git blob 9574f5bbf92f04ccc2fc37332eebfe1434f973f7 and test_handoff_wakes.py blob bd83406bb7508fae7ac040f3d013cfe7db262445. Follow channels/tarik-wake-protocol.md. This is your only scheduled-wake assignment. Fetch the latest tested private tarik-bot/local_tick.py and its handoff-wake tests from LindsayRidgeway/llm-symposium-bots, together with bot.py and test_continuity.py from private commits 59240440188d4d7e1484baa76d38a561f717f551 and 7fd03380f6c5a05acde8c86172bef4cbda1c1421. Compare the active local source and reconcile intervening changes instead of overwriting them. Install the handoff-only worker and the continuity fix using the existing service owner; preserve model/provider/cadence/credentials and one Telegram receiver. Read no private Dawn content or credential values. Verify the queued worker skips empty or failed queue reads before any model call, and uses only claimed handoffs. Keep this task in progress until actual deployed hashes and service/context results are observed. Persist a nonsecret result artifact and the matching queue outcome before any self-restart that would otherwise interrupt landing, or use a safe deferred restart. Never mark source publication as runtime deployment. If the new private worker is not available or local deployment is genuinely blocked, record that exact fact; do not substitute unrelated general work.
tasks.expected_result: A public nonsecret result artifact records deployed local_tick.py/bot.py hashes, offline checks, the existing service owner and single Telegram receiver, a fresh shared-context check, and an empty-queue test showing zero executor/model calls. The local dispatcher reads only this handoff queue. Matching claim-token completion preserves other queue tasks. No unrelated bot, hardware, credential, billing, or model setting changes.
allowed_targets: Tarik's active local_tick.py and handoff-wake test file
The isolated commons checkout's handoff queue and result artifacts
